```{r load_and_prepare, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(gtsummary)
library(pROC)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dev = "pdf",
  dpi = 300,
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  out.width = "90%"
)

# ============================================================================
# DATA LOADING AND TRAIN/TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================================

data <- read_excel("~/Downloads/Tox Book.v2.xlsx", sheet = "INTOXICATE")

# Add row identifier (1-indexed to match Excel)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())

# Define valid exposure categories
valid_categories <- c("Combination", "Analgesic", "Antidepressants",
                      "Street Drugs", "CO, As, CN", "Sedatives", "Alcohol", "Unknown")

# Clean and prepare data
clean_data_all <- data %>%
  filter(row_id != 82) %>%  # Exclude row 82 (withdrawal)
  filter(!is.na(Gender), !is.na(`Exposure Category`), !is.na(Age)) %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = trimws(Gender),
    `Exposure Category` = trimws(`Exposure Category`),
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    `Respiratory Insufficiency` = case_when(
      tolower(`Respiratory Insufficiency`) == "yes" ~ "Yes",
      tolower(`Respiratory Insufficiency`) == "no" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Cirrhosis = case_when(
      tolower(Cirrhosis) == "yes" ~ "Yes",
      tolower(Cirrhosis) == "no" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Dysrhythmia = case_when(
      tolower(Dysrhythmia) == "yes" ~ "Yes",
      tolower(Dysrhythmia) == "no" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    `Secondary Reason for ICU Admission` = case_when(
      tolower(`Secondary Reason for ICU Admission`) == "yes" ~ "Yes",
      tolower(`Secondary Reason for ICU Admission`) == "no" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    `Actual Disposition` = case_when(
      tolower(`Actual Disposition`) == "icu" ~ "ICU",
      tolower(`Actual Disposition`) == "gmf" ~ "GMF",
      grepl("discharge", tolower(`Actual Disposition`)) ~ "Discharge",
      TRUE ~ `Actual Disposition`
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Age >= 12) %>%
  filter(Gender %in% c("M", "F")) %>%
  filter(`Exposure Category` %in% valid_categories)

# Create train/test split
clean_data_all <- clean_data_all %>%
  mutate(dataset = ifelse(row_id <= 112, "train", "test"))

# Split datasets
train_data <- clean_data_all %>% filter(dataset == "train")
test_data <- clean_data_all %>% filter(dataset == "test")

n_train <- nrow(train_data)
n_test <- nrow(test_data)
n_total <- nrow(clean_data_all)

# Prepare regression data
prepare_reg_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Gender_binary = ifelse(Gender == "M", 1, 0),
      Dysrhythmia_binary = ifelse(Dysrhythmia == "Yes", 1, 0),
      GCS_numeric = as.numeric(GCS),
      Outcome_binary = ifelse(`Actual Disposition` == "ICU", 1, 0),
      Pulse = as.numeric(Pulse),
      Age = as.numeric(Age),
      SBP = as.numeric(SBP)
    )
}

reg_train <- prepare_reg_data(train_data)
reg_test <- prepare_reg_data(test_data)
reg_all <- prepare_reg_data(clean_data_all)

# Helper function
format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))
}

cat("\n=== TRAIN/TEST SPLIT SUMMARY ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Training set (OLD - published study): n = %d\n", n_train))
cat(sprintf("Test set (NEW - validation): n = %d\n", n_test))
cat(sprintf("Total: n = %d\n", n_total))
cat("================================\n\n")
```

# PART 1: DEMOGRAPHICS

```{r demographics}
# Demographics with IQR - OVERALL
demo_by_sex <- reg_all %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct = round(100 * n() / nrow(reg_all)),
    median_age = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_age = quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_age = quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_age = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

female_stats <- demo_by_sex %>% filter(Gender == "F")
male_stats <- demo_by_sex %>% filter(Gender == "M")

# Overall demographics
overall_demo <- reg_all %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_age = quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_age = quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("\n=== DEMOGRAPHICS FOR ABSTRACT (OVERALL) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total: n = %d\n", n_total))
cat(sprintf("Females: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n", 
            female_stats$n, female_stats$pct, 
            round(female_stats$median_age), round(female_stats$q1_age), round(female_stats$q3_age)))
cat(sprintf("Males: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n", 
            male_stats$n, male_stats$pct,
            round(male_stats$median_age), round(male_stats$q1_age), round(male_stats$q3_age)))
cat("================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# DEMOGRAPHICS BY DATASET (Original vs New) - FOR MIKE'S ABSTRACT
# ============================================================================

demo_by_dataset_sex <- reg_all %>%
  group_by(dataset, Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_age = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_age = quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_age = quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Original dataset (train)
orig_female <- demo_by_dataset_sex %>% filter(dataset == "train", Gender == "F")
orig_male <- demo_by_dataset_sex %>% filter(dataset == "train", Gender == "M")

# New dataset (test)
new_female <- demo_by_dataset_sex %>% filter(dataset == "test", Gender == "F")
new_male <- demo_by_dataset_sex %>% filter(dataset == "test", Gender == "M")

cat("\n=== DEMOGRAPHICS BY DATASET (FOR ABSTRACT) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("\nORIGINAL DATASET (n=%d):\n", n_train))
cat(sprintf("  Females: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n", 
            orig_female$n, round(100*orig_female$n/n_train), 
            round(orig_female$median_age), round(orig_female$q1_age), round(orig_female$q3_age)))
cat(sprintf("  Males: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n", 
            orig_male$n, round(100*orig_male$n/n_train),
            round(orig_male$median_age), round(orig_male$q1_age), round(orig_male$q3_age)))

cat(sprintf("\nNEW DATASET (n=%d):\n", n_test))
cat(sprintf("  Females: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n", 
            new_female$n, round(100*new_female$n/n_test), 
            round(new_female$median_age), round(new_female$q1_age), round(new_female$q3_age)))
cat(sprintf("  Males: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n", 
            new_male$n, round(100*new_male$n/n_test),
            round(new_male$median_age), round(new_male$q1_age), round(new_male$q3_age)))
cat("================================\n\n")
```

# PART 2: SEX DIFFERENCES IN EXPOSURE PATTERNS

```{r sex_exposure_analysis}
# Chi-square test
cont_table <- table(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category`, clean_data_all$Gender)
chi_result <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(cont_table))
chi_p_value <- format_p(chi_result$p.value)

# Antidepressants comparison
create_binary_comparison <- function(data, target_category) {
  data %>%
    mutate(category_binary = ifelse(`Exposure Category` == target_category,
      target_category, "All Others"))
}

antidep_data <- create_binary_comparison(clean_data_all, "Antidepressants")
antidep_table <- table(antidep_data$category_binary, antidep_data$Gender)
antidep_fisher <- fisher.test(antidep_table)

# Calculate odds ratio manually to verify
n_antidep_f <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` == "Antidepressants" & clean_data_all$Gender == "F")
n_antidep_m <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` == "Antidepressants" & clean_data_all$Gender == "M")
n_other_f <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` != "Antidepressants" & clean_data_all$Gender == "F")
n_other_m <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` != "Antidepressants" & clean_data_all$Gender == "M")

# OR = (a/c) / (b/d) = (antidep_f/other_f) / (antidep_m/other_m)
or_manual <- (n_antidep_f / n_other_f) / (n_antidep_m / n_other_m)

# Bonferroni correction
bonf_antidep <- min(1, antidep_fisher$p.value * 4)

# CO/As/CN comparison for occupational exposures
co_data <- create_binary_comparison(clean_data_all, "CO, As, CN")
co_table <- table(co_data$category_binary, co_data$Gender)
co_fisher <- fisher.test(co_table)

n_co_f <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` == "CO, As, CN" & clean_data_all$Gender == "F")
n_co_m <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` == "CO, As, CN" & clean_data_all$Gender == "M")
n_co_other_f <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` != "CO, As, CN" & clean_data_all$Gender == "F")
n_co_other_m <- sum(clean_data_all$`Exposure Category` != "CO, As, CN" & clean_data_all$Gender == "M")

or_co_manual <- (n_co_m / n_co_other_m) / (n_co_f / n_co_other_f)

cat("\n=== SEX-EXPOSURE ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Chi-square p-value: %s\n", chi_p_value))
cat(sprintf("Antidepressants: %d female (%d%%), %d male (%d%%)\n", 
            n_antidep_f, round(100*n_antidep_f/(n_antidep_f+n_antidep_m)),
            n_antidep_m, round(100*n_antidep_m/(n_antidep_f+n_antidep_m))))
cat(sprintf("OR (manual calc): %.2f\n", or_manual))
cat(sprintf("OR (Fisher): %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f - %.2f)\n", 
            antidep_fisher$estimate, antidep_fisher$conf.int[1], antidep_fisher$conf.int[2]))
cat(sprintf("Fisher p-value: %s\n", format_p(antidep_fisher$p.value)))
cat(sprintf("Bonferroni adjusted p: %s\n", format_p(bonf_antidep)))
cat(sprintf("\nCO/As/CN (occupational): %d female (%d%%), %d male (%d%%)\n",
            n_co_f, round(100*n_co_f/(n_co_f+n_co_m)),
            n_co_m, round(100*n_co_m/(n_co_f+n_co_m))))
cat(sprintf("OR for males: %.2f\n", or_co_manual))
cat("================================\n\n")
```

## Table 1. Distribution of Exposure Categories by Sex

```{r table1_sex}
table1_data <- clean_data_all %>%
  mutate(Exposure = as.character(`Exposure Category`)) %>%
  count(Exposure, Gender) %>%
  group_by(Exposure) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    pct = round(100 * n / total)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Exposure,
    names_from = Gender,
    values_from = c(n, pct)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Female = paste0(n_F, " (", pct_F, ")"),
    Male = paste0(n_M, " (", pct_M, ")"),
    Total = n_F + n_M
  ) %>%
  select(Exposure, Female, Male, Total)

totals <- data.frame(
  Exposure = "Total",
  Female = paste0(female_stats$n, " (", female_stats$pct, ")"),
  Male = paste0(male_stats$n, " (", male_stats$pct, ")"),
  Total = n_total,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

table1_final <- rbind(table1_data, totals)
table1_final$Pvalue <- c(chi_p_value, rep("", nrow(table1_final) - 1))

kable(table1_final,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  col.names = c("Exposure", "Female", "Male", "Total", "P-value")
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"))
```

# PART 2B: ADOLESCENT SUBGROUP ANALYSIS (Ages 12-19)

```{r adolescent_subgroup}
# Filter for adolescent age group (12-19 years)
adolescent_data <- clean_data_all %>%
  filter(Age >= 12 & Age <= 19)

n_adolescent <- nrow(adolescent_data)

# Demographics for adolescent subgroup
adolescent_demo <- adolescent_data %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct = round(100 * n() / nrow(adolescent_data)),
    median_age = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_age = quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_age = quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

adolescent_female <- adolescent_demo %>% filter(Gender == "F")
adolescent_male <- adolescent_demo %>% filter(Gender == "M")

# Chi-square test for adolescent subgroup
adolescent_cont_table <- table(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category`, adolescent_data$Gender)
adolescent_chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(adolescent_cont_table))
adolescent_chi_p <- format_p(adolescent_chi$p.value)

# Antidepressants in adolescent subgroup
adolescent_antidep_data <- create_binary_comparison(adolescent_data, "Antidepressants")
adolescent_antidep_table <- table(adolescent_antidep_data$category_binary, adolescent_antidep_data$Gender)
adolescent_antidep_fisher <- fisher.test(adolescent_antidep_table)

n_adolescent_antidep_f <- sum(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category` == "Antidepressants" & adolescent_data$Gender == "F")
n_adolescent_antidep_m <- sum(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category` == "Antidepressants" & adolescent_data$Gender == "M")
n_adolescent_other_f <- sum(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category` != "Antidepressants" & adolescent_data$Gender == "F")
n_adolescent_other_m <- sum(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category` != "Antidepressants" & adolescent_data$Gender == "M")

adolescent_or_manual <- (n_adolescent_antidep_f / n_adolescent_other_f) / (n_adolescent_antidep_m / n_adolescent_other_m)
adolescent_bonf_antidep <- min(1, adolescent_antidep_fisher$p.value * 4)

# Analgesics in adolescent subgroup
n_adolescent_analgesic_f <- sum(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category` == "Analgesic" & adolescent_data$Gender == "F")
n_adolescent_analgesic_m <- sum(adolescent_data$`Exposure Category` == "Analgesic" & adolescent_data$Gender == "M")

cat("\n=== ADOLESCENT SUBGROUP (Ages 12-19) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total adolescents: n = %d\n", n_adolescent))
cat(sprintf("Females: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n",
            adolescent_female$n, adolescent_female$pct,
            round(adolescent_female$median_age), 
            round(adolescent_female$q1_age), 
            round(adolescent_female$q3_age)))
cat(sprintf("Males: %d (%d%%), median age %d [IQR %d-%d]\n",
            adolescent_male$n, adolescent_male$pct,
            round(adolescent_male$median_age),
            round(adolescent_male$q1_age),
            round(adolescent_male$q3_age)))
cat(sprintf("\nChi-square p-value: %s\n", adolescent_chi_p))
cat(sprintf("Antidepressants: %d female (%d%%), %d male (%d%%)\n",
            n_adolescent_antidep_f,
            round(100*n_adolescent_antidep_f/(n_adolescent_antidep_f+n_adolescent_antidep_m)),
            n_adolescent_antidep_m,
            round(100*n_adolescent_antidep_m/(n_adolescent_antidep_f+n_adolescent_antidep_m))))
cat(sprintf("OR (manual calc): %.2f\n", adolescent_or_manual))
cat(sprintf("OR (Fisher): %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f - %.2f)\n",
            adolescent_antidep_fisher$estimate,
            adolescent_antidep_fisher$conf.int[1],
            adolescent_antidep_fisher$conf.int[2]))
cat(sprintf("Fisher p-value: %s\n", format_p(adolescent_antidep_fisher$p.value)))
cat(sprintf("Bonferroni adjusted p: %s\n", format_p(adolescent_bonf_antidep)))
cat(sprintf("\nAnalgesics: %d female (%d%%), %d male (%d%%)\n",
            n_adolescent_analgesic_f,
            round(100*n_adolescent_analgesic_f/(n_adolescent_analgesic_f+n_adolescent_analgesic_m)),
            n_adolescent_analgesic_m,
            round(100*n_adolescent_analgesic_m/(n_adolescent_analgesic_f+n_adolescent_analgesic_m))))
cat("================================\n\n")
```

# PART 3: PREDICTION MODEL ANALYSIS (Train/Test Validation)

```{r model_analysis}
# ============================================================================
# PREPARE OUTCOME DATA
# ============================================================================

outcome_train <- reg_train %>%
  filter(!is.na(Outcome_binary), !is.na(Age), !is.na(GCS_numeric), 
         !is.na(Pulse), !is.na(SBP), !is.na(`Respiratory Insufficiency`),
         !is.na(Cirrhosis), !is.na(Dysrhythmia_binary),
         !is.na(`Secondary Reason for ICU Admission`))

outcome_test <- reg_test %>%
  filter(!is.na(Outcome_binary), !is.na(Age), !is.na(GCS_numeric), 
         !is.na(Pulse), !is.na(SBP), !is.na(`Respiratory Insufficiency`),
         !is.na(Cirrhosis), !is.na(Dysrhythmia_binary),
         !is.na(`Secondary Reason for ICU Admission`))

n_train_outcome <- nrow(outcome_train)
n_test_outcome <- nrow(outcome_test)
n_icu_train <- sum(outcome_train$Outcome_binary == 1)
n_icu_test <- sum(outcome_test$Outcome_binary == 1)

cat("\n=== OUTCOME MODELING SAMPLE SIZES ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Training: n=%d (ICU cases: %d, %.1f%%)\n", n_train_outcome, n_icu_train, 100*n_icu_train/n_train_outcome))
cat(sprintf("Test: n=%d (ICU cases: %d, %.1f%%)\n", n_test_outcome, n_icu_test, 100*n_icu_test/n_test_outcome))
cat("================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# FIT MODELS ON TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================================

# Model WITHOUT sex (base model)
model_without_sex <- glm(
  Outcome_binary ~ Age + GCS_numeric + Pulse + SBP + 
    `Respiratory Insufficiency` + Cirrhosis + 
    Dysrhythmia_binary + `Secondary Reason for ICU Admission`,
  data = outcome_train, 
  family = binomial
)

# Model WITH sex
model_with_sex <- glm(
  Outcome_binary ~ Gender_binary + Age + GCS_numeric + Pulse + SBP + 
    `Respiratory Insufficiency` + Cirrhosis + 
    Dysrhythmia_binary + `Secondary Reason for ICU Admission`,
  data = outcome_train, 
  family = binomial
)

# Sex coefficient
sex_coef <- coef(summary(model_with_sex))["Gender_binary", ]

# Likelihood ratio test
lrt_sex <- anova(model_without_sex, model_with_sex, test = "Chisq")
lrt_sex_p <- lrt_sex$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

cat("\n=== SEX COEFFICIENT (Training Data) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Beta: %.3f\n", sex_coef["Estimate"]))
cat(sprintf("SE: %.3f\n", sex_coef["Std. Error"]))
cat(sprintf("P-value: %s\n", format_p(sex_coef["Pr(>|z|)"])))
cat(sprintf("LRT p-value: %s\n", format_p(lrt_sex_p)))
cat("================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# TEST SET EVALUATION - USING FIXED THRESHOLD (0.5)
# ============================================================================

# Predict on test set
pred_without_sex <- predict(model_without_sex, newdata = outcome_test, type = "response")
pred_with_sex <- predict(model_with_sex, newdata = outcome_test, type = "response")

# Use fixed threshold of 0.5
threshold <- 0.5

# Calculate sens/spec at fixed threshold
calc_metrics <- function(pred, actual, thresh) {
  pred_class <- ifelse(pred >= thresh, 1, 0)
  TP <- sum(pred_class == 1 & actual == 1)
  TN <- sum(pred_class == 0 & actual == 0)
  FP <- sum(pred_class == 1 & actual == 0)
  FN <- sum(pred_class == 0 & actual == 1)
  
  sens <- TP / (TP + FN)
  spec <- TN / (TN + FP)
  ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)
  npv <- TN / (TN + FN)
  
  list(sens = sens, spec = spec, ppv = ppv, npv = npv, 
       TP = TP, TN = TN, FP = FP, FN = FN)
}

metrics_without <- calc_metrics(pred_without_sex, outcome_test$Outcome_binary, threshold)
metrics_with <- calc_metrics(pred_with_sex, outcome_test$Outcome_binary, threshold)

# ROC and AUC
roc_without <- roc(outcome_test$Outcome_binary, pred_without_sex, quiet = TRUE)
roc_with <- roc(outcome_test$Outcome_binary, pred_with_sex, quiet = TRUE)

auc_without <- auc(roc_without)
auc_with <- auc(roc_with)

# DeLong test for AUC comparison
roc_test <- roc.test(roc_with, roc_without, method = "delong")

cat("\n=== TEST SET PERFORMANCE (Threshold = 0.5) ===\n")
cat("Model WITHOUT Sex:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_without$sens * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_without$spec * 100))
cat(sprintf("  AUC: %.3f\n", auc_without))
cat("\nModel WITH Sex:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_with$sens * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_with$spec * 100))
cat(sprintf("  AUC: %.3f\n", auc_with))
cat(sprintf("\nDeLong test p-value: %s\n", format_p(roc_test$p.value)))
cat("================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ALSO COMPUTE WITH YOUDEN-OPTIMAL THRESHOLD (for reference)
# Find optimal threshold on TRAINING data, then apply to TEST
# ============================================================================

# Get predictions on training data
pred_train_without <- predict(model_without_sex, type = "response")
pred_train_with <- predict(model_with_sex, type = "response")

# Find optimal thresholds on training data
roc_train_without <- roc(outcome_train$Outcome_binary, pred_train_without, quiet = TRUE)
roc_train_with <- roc(outcome_train$Outcome_binary, pred_train_with, quiet = TRUE)

thresh_without <- coords(roc_train_without, "best", best.method = "youden")$threshold
thresh_with <- coords(roc_train_with, "best", best.method = "youden")$threshold

# Apply training-optimal thresholds to test data
metrics_without_opt <- calc_metrics(pred_without_sex, outcome_test$Outcome_binary, thresh_without)
metrics_with_opt <- calc_metrics(pred_with_sex, outcome_test$Outcome_binary, thresh_with)

cat("\n=== TEST SET PERFORMANCE (Training-Optimal Thresholds) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Threshold WITHOUT sex (from training): %.3f\n", thresh_without))
cat(sprintf("Threshold WITH sex (from training): %.3f\n", thresh_with))
cat("\nModel WITHOUT Sex:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_without_opt$sens * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_without_opt$spec * 100))
cat("\nModel WITH Sex:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_with_opt$sens * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_with_opt$spec * 100))
cat("================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# USE SAME THRESHOLD FOR BOTH MODELS (fairer comparison)
# ============================================================================

# Use the threshold from the WITHOUT-sex model for both
shared_thresh <- thresh_without

metrics_without_shared <- calc_metrics(pred_without_sex, outcome_test$Outcome_binary, shared_thresh)
metrics_with_shared <- calc_metrics(pred_with_sex, outcome_test$Outcome_binary, shared_thresh)

cat("\n=== TEST SET PERFORMANCE (Same Threshold for Both) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Shared threshold (from model without sex): %.3f\n", shared_thresh))
cat("\nModel WITHOUT Sex:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_without_shared$sens * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_without_shared$spec * 100))
cat("\nModel WITH Sex:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_with_shared$sens * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.1f%%\n", metrics_with_shared$spec * 100))
cat("================================\n\n")
```

# CONCLUSION

**Key findings:**

1. **Sex-Exposure Association (Full Cohort):** Chi-square p = `r chi_p_value`. Antidepressants: `r round(100*n_antidep_f/(n_antidep_f+n_antidep_m))`% female (OR `r sprintf("%.1f", or_manual)`, Fisher p = `r format_p(antidep_fisher$p.value)`, Bonferroni adjusted p = `r format_p(bonf_antidep)`).

2. **Adolescent Subgroup (Ages 12-19):** n = `r n_adolescent`. Chi-square p = `r adolescent_chi_p`. Antidepressants: `r round(100*n_adolescent_antidep_f/(n_adolescent_antidep_f+n_adolescent_antidep_m))`% female (OR `r sprintf("%.1f", adolescent_or_manual)`, Fisher p = `r format_p(adolescent_antidep_fisher$p.value)`, Bonferroni adjusted p = `r format_p(adolescent_bonf_antidep)`).

3. **Sex in Prediction Model:** LRT p = `r format_p(lrt_sex_p)`. Sex coefficient β = `r sprintf("%.2f", sex_coef["Estimate"])` (p = `r format_p(sex_coef["Pr(>|z|)"])`).

4. **Test Set Performance:** AUC without sex = `r sprintf("%.3f", auc_without)`, AUC with sex = `r sprintf("%.3f", auc_with)` (DeLong p = `r format_p(roc_test$p.value)`).

**Recommendation for abstract:** Report sensitivity/specificity as primary metrics. Including biological sex in the model changed sensitivity from `r sprintf("%.0f", metrics_without$sens * 100)`% to `r sprintf("%.0f", metrics_with$sens * 100)`% and specificity from `r sprintf("%.0f", metrics_without$spec * 100)`% to `r sprintf("%.0f", metrics_with$spec * 100)`%. Adolescent subgroup findings can be added to Results section.
